item.text:
Completed the cloud time-series analysis and visualization.

- Original scalar field: [01_original_scalar_field.png](/workspace/cloud_results/01_original_scalar_field.png)
- Persistence-simplified (0.5) EMD-tracked PL maxima, rendered as radius-2 spheres over a cool-to-warm scalar field: [02_tracked_maxima_emd.png](/workspace/cloud_results/02_tracked_maxima_emd.png)
- ParaView state: [cloud_tracking_pipeline.pvsm](/workspace/cloud_results/cloud_tracking_pipeline.pvsm)
- Track geometry: [tracked_maxima_emd.vtp](/workspace/cloud_results/tracked_maxima_emd.vtp)
- Reproducible script: [cloud_tracking.py](/workspace/cloud_tracking.py)

The tracking uses the Wasserstein/EMD assignment mode across `cloud1.vti`–`cloud3.vti`.
